facts.fact: Revises F574: Ila says she burned the sheets this morning when she and Kunal came in, on coals banked under ash in the hut hearth. Kunal notes there was no smoke, Ila says banked coals give none, and he lets it go by choice. He finds only ambiguous ash and does not touch her hands.

Ila reasons she cannot truly burn the sheets: they are the only true record of the hills, including Hari's scratched warnings and the map she means to share with both courts, and burning them before Kunal would be one more loss for him to watch.
Kunal sat silent through two of Meera's drafting-table sessions and saw her amputation glove (consistent with F446, F576), so he knows what one touch of Ila's hand would teach him.
